snippet.title: Fling Friends - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Fling Friends is a chaotic co-op physics platformer where one fling yeets everyone! Solve color-based puzzles, climb together (or fall together), and laugh your way through a vibrant Arabian-inspired world.

لعبة Fling "Friends"، وهي لعبة تعاونية (3D Co-op) حيث أنت واصحابك مربوطين بحبل. ستقومون بالقفز، والسحب، والدفع، بينما تحاولون اجتياز الألغاز والفوضى.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3986580/FLING_FRIENDS/
Discord: https://discord.gg/pRRst3UR8a
X: https://x.com/OFFBOXStudios
